results.summary: FOMC April 29 2026: held rates 3.50-3.75% (8-4 vote split — most dissents since Oct 1992). Miran voted for immediate 25bp cut; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing bias language. Powell's likely last meeting as chair. Inflation elevated due to Middle East energy prices. Market pricing zero cuts 2026, one 25bp cut December 2027.
